name: Set of 3 Floral Wall Frames – Wooden Decorative Art in 8x11 & 12x16 Inches with Double Tape for Easy Mounting
description: Bring the beauty of nature indoors with this elegant set of 3 floral wall frames, designed to add freshness, charm, and a modern artistic touch to any living space. Crafted from high-quality wooden material, these frames are available in two sizes – 8x11 inches and 12x16 inches – making them versatile for bedrooms, living rooms, hallways, or offices. Each frame features vibrant floral designs in rich, eye-catching colors that blend seamlessly with both contemporary and traditional interiors. For added convenience, the frames come with strong double tape, allowing you to mount them easily on your walls without nails or drilling. Perfect as a stylish home décor piece or as a thoughtful gift for loved ones, these floral frames elevate your space with elegance, positivity, and timeless beauty.
